stem: A school in Nakuru is deciding between buying its own servers and using a cloud provider with pay-as-you-go pricing. Which statement correctly compares the two approaches?
option_a: Buying servers is an up-front capital expense (CapEx), while pay-as-you-go cloud is an ongoing operational expense (OpEx)
option_b: Both approaches are ongoing operational expenses
option_c: Buying servers is an operational expense, while pay-as-you-go cloud is a capital expense
option_d: Both approaches require paying for all hardware up front
why_correct: Buying servers is capital expenditure (CapEx): money spent up front on physical infrastructure. Cloud services are paid for as they are consumed over time, so they are operational expenditure (OpEx).
why_b_wrong: Buying your own servers is an up-front purchase, not an ongoing operating cost.
why_c_wrong: This reverses the two: buying servers is CapEx and pay-as-you-go cloud is OpEx.
why_d_wrong: Pay-as-you-go cloud pricing does not require buying hardware up front.
